text: I switched from Vim to VS Code last month.
I no longer drink coffee after lunch.
My team moved the daily standup to ten in the morning.
The project was renamed from Falcon to Orion.
I changed my default language from Java to Kotlin for new services.
We upgraded the database from PostgreSQL 14 to 15 last weekend.
My email address was updated to the new company domain.
I stopped using Docker Desktop and moved to Podman.
The release schedule was moved up by one week.
I am not using Windows anymore, my work laptop runs Linux now.
Our retry limit was increased from three to five.
I switched my meetings to the afternoon.
The staging environment was reset to a clean state yesterday.
I no longer work on the billing team, I moved to search.
My preferred code formatter changed from Black to Ruff.
The code review policy was updated to require two approvals.
We discontinued the old reporting dashboard in favor of Grafana.
I was switched to the night on-call shift this month.
The test timeout was raised to sixty seconds.
I decided to skip the weekly newsletter and read the release notes instead.
